tex_content.html:
Theorem
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0053 1. Theorem 2.15\group neckpinch

For $n\ge 2$, an open set of $\SO (n+1)$-invariant metrics on $S^{n+1}$ develops a Type-I neckpinch at a finite time $T$, and any parabolic blow-up at the developing singularity converges to the shrinking cylinder soliton $ds^2+2(n-1)(T-t)g_{\mathrm{can}}$.
